sense.text:
“Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus”. That is the work: we warn every man and every woman so that they may be presented perfect in the sight of Christ. Brother, it is time to stop; it is time to build in. Every one of these classes is a warning to our people, because destruction is coming.

That warning is what we do in the streets, in the classroom, on the radio show and on the TV show. We are in the business of warning people, for the destruction to come and for the fire that is coming to hit this place.

A soul that has no purpose is going to be destroyed; it is going to be gone. So you must have a purpose in this truth. Ask yourself every morning why the Lord chose you out of thousands. He knows where you were, and you know where you are now, and how the Lord could have removed you. The Lord has everybody numbered: he knows the number that is going to be sealed, the 144, the leading men, and the women, men and children who come in behind them. This earth is huge, there are too many places to go and too much work to be done, and there is no time to argue with foolishness. Some brothers have never been off their block, never been on a plane or a boat.

So what is your purpose? Just to sit here, to come on the feast days and do nothing? Some are so caught up in their own minds, burdened over a brother who hurt them, a sister who hurt them, an officer they don't like, a brother who didn't call them on time, that they won't teach their own people. Everybody points the finger and nobody focuses on the mission. We have to reach as many as we can before the Lord takes us out of here.

Christ died for the life you used to live, the wicked life, giving you a chance before he brings the fire. Now you are living his life, and you have to do his work. This truth is the balance to your life; there is no other life to balance it with. And Sabbath sickness is a whole slogan for brothers who are lazy bums.

precepts.why:
This is how deep the warning is: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”. That is why we warn every man and every woman in this truth, and why nobody here is playing with any of you. Back then it was water, but the Lord promised that this time it is going to be fire, and that fire is able to burn your soul. You are able to feel it while you are in it. So get out of that foolishness, the whole burden you create inside your head about why people don't like you. A lot of people didn't like Christ; did he let that stop his mission? A lot of people didn't like the prophets; did the prophets stop preaching?

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”. It is their pride that will win them the lake of fire, and their wickedness that brings the fire on them. So you cannot be prideful. Christ died for your sin. He could have taken you out in that moment, but he gave you that grace and that mercy, so that you would get up off your behind, build upon the platform of Christ, and go out and gather the souls of our people that Satan is oppressing, the fatherless and the widow. Instead some are out here playing games. Are you damn crazy?

“And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” We are fighting demons every day, and the fight is within: when you fast, it is not that you cannot do it; you have to command yourself to do it. That is why we warn every man and every woman. Whatever you are into, it is time to let it go before the fire comes.

Why we warn: “If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.” That is what God wants us to do: take heed and turn from your evil ways, so that he may repent himself of the evil he is about to hit us with because of the evil of our doings.

So go deep within yourself. You need that time to meditate and search out what is going on within you, the way you would research anything else. If you keep finding yourself having problems with brothers, something is wrong with you, physically or mentally, and it is not Christ. The greatest commandment is to love God with all your heart and love your neighbour as yourself; why would anyone have time for hatred? There is a seed in you that is choking you. Get rid of that damn seed before it grows into bitterness you can't come out of, and the next thing you know the couch is better than coming to class. Brothers and sisters who say, I'm going through things, stop calling me, and who speak evil when someone reaches out to see about their welfare, are playing games.

“And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you, To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened”. Every morning the Lord sends his prophets out to warn the people, and they won't take heed. When the fire comes, they will blame God and say he is not a good God. But he is telling you what to do; he is reaching out.

If anybody offends you, apply the Bible and take it to somebody. Sometimes the devil is so depressing you that you think a person offended you who doesn't even know it. That is how sick we are as a people. This is a hospital. Shake it off and put on your beautiful garments, O Israel: all the things you create in your mind are dust, so shake off the dust. Look at the platform we are establishing, brothers travelling to other countries, and consider yourself: I'm not doing enough. Don't sit on the couch plotting evil like an evil woman.

“Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.” When you have evil thoughts, you have to fight them and learn to do well. Constantly examine yourself; as Paul said, prove yourself, see if you are of that faith. If you believe in brotherly love, if you believe this is a family, keep checking your spirit on that.

After that God says, “Come now, and let us reason together”. You see your condition; you see what you are going through. You hardly know who you are in this captivity. When God speaks of our condition, the reason for it is that we broke his laws, not the things people create out of their own heads.

“Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.” The Lord says, I will give you a chance; I will clean you up; I will help you. “If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land”. If you are willing to be obedient to what he said, he will do this for you. That is what Christ did for us when he died on the cross. Yet we carry so much hate in our hearts for our brothers, like the Pharisees after Christ and the apostles: when Satan entered them, they could not control the hatred they had for their own kind. Don't be out here breaking bread with hatred for your brothers. We are at war, and every man, every soldier, is needed.

“But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.” Look at the black community: we have been devoured with the sword of God. That is the wrath of God. The Lord is not playing with us. He said, let us reason; if you decide not to do what he said, he will devour you and put you in a condition for a long time. Our people in Christianity are in a blind state of mind; their whole mind is darkness.

That is how we know there is a God: when we look at our condition. Islam cannot change it, Christianity cannot change it, and surely voodoo cannot change it, or it would have changed Haiti. The only one who can change our condition is God, so turn back to the true God. The King of kings had nowhere to rest; he had a lot of work to do in this earth before he was gone, and we have to push this truth to as many people as we can. And don't come into the Lord's house with a sad face. It is supposed to be a place of joy; everybody has problems.

Between “Come now, and let us reason together” and the rest of that verse, Isaiah goes back to show the condition God is reasoning with us about: “Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord”.

That is what we became: a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters, a people that forsook the Lord. That is the condition, and it came because we broke his laws. That is why every man has to be warned.

“Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves”. That is how we became a rebellious people. The children of Israel have the most powerful law in the universe, so powerful that even people who decide not to keep God's laws are still hit by them. You can decide you don't want to get married, but look at the black community: a bunch of baby mothers. The law is still active. Without God's law we become degenerate.

“Every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards”. That is what America does: it gives the welfare, the housing, the Section 8, and feeds the so-called leaders. Whichever one it sees has the potential to be a threat, it raises up and gives a nice home, and he will sell his own mother for the dollar bill; a lot of these pastors. And the brothers who are not pastors or superstars will sell their butt just to get that dollar. That is how powerful the dollar is. Nasty. A woman today with a fake butt, why would a brother aim for that? That is a garbage can, like America full of garbage. Something is wrong with us as a people.

The devil comes in every form, because you don't want to be satisfied with how the Lord created you. The glue that goes on those things the sisters put on can go into the blood and create all types of diseases, and so with the wig and the rest. Our people have to wake up from this dead state of mind. “They judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.”

“Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies”. You become the enemy of God when you disobey him, and he says he will avenge himself of his enemies. So for those in the black community who don't repent, you are looking at God's vengeance upon our people. He said, let us reason; you don't see your condition, you don't see the state of mind I have you in, so why not repent and come back to me, and I can clean you up. But the people refuse to return. So he says, all right, since you don't want to return, I have something for you.

sense.text:
The fire is not there to burn you; the fire is there to purify you, to take out the things you have in you. A good life is not an easy life. A lot of people fear these things, but these elements work together, so there is no need to fear them when they are happening.

“Prosperity and adversity”: you will always find those two together. In prosperity you would not know who is a friend; in adversity you would know that he was never a friend. “Life and death”: where you find life, you are going to find death. “Poverty and riches”: where you find poverty, you will find people that have the money. They all “come of the Lord.”

So why do you want to balance your life? Nobody's life is balanced. Your profession is this work; put that work in. You sit there doing nothing and say, Lord, I want that blessing; Lord, I need this new job. What are you doing? Nothing. So where is the blessing going to come from? We need you in the field, out there doing your thing, building yourself up.

“Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord”. If you find yourself in poverty, put your trust in the Lord; if you find yourself rich, put your trust in the Lord; in life or in death, put your trust in the Lord, because that is who life and death, prosperity and adversity all come from. Look at Job, a perfect example: Satan came before God, and look at what happened to Job. Some of us are going through that right now. Don't let it destroy you; it is supposed to build you up.

Whatever condition you find yourself in, what is going to fight against your trust is your thoughts. You are fighting within. So you say: I might not understand what I'm going through right now, but I have to go through it, because the Lord is trying to teach me something. That is how you put your trust in the Lord.

In the world we did whatever we had to do. In this truth there are eyes watching over you, and the demon you had on you does not want to be controlled. That is why, when a lot of brothers and sisters bounce out of here, Satan takes full control of them. You catch them in the grocery store back in pants, showing all their breasts, going back to being the hoe they were. They never understood the law. There is nowhere you can go and hide from the truth. Humble yourself, learn this truth, learn how to do well.

When it throws off your bank account, when the fire comes, you put your trust in the Lord. You don't have anybody else but the Lord, and the brothers and sisters to comfort you. The scriptures show these things are going to happen; there is no if or maybe. If you are weak now, wanting to give up, not wanting to deal with your sister or your brother, not humbling yourself, what will you do when these things happen? But if you put your trust in the Lord, you can understand that what you are going through is of the Lord, and you have to go through that door.

“And whose hope the Lord is.” That is all you have: God is our hope, and without him we are nothing. It is easy to do illegal things and go back into the world. But a man who can control himself, who can discipline himself, is the most powerful man.

“For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river”. The brother who trusts in the Lord and makes the Lord his hope, the Lord is going to nourish; the sister too. Imagine a little plant close to a river: it will never lack water. When we gather in the war room, look at which brothers come to get some of that water. Some you haven't seen up there in two or three weeks, because they don't want that wisdom; they don't want that water; they don't want to be nourished.

“And shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green”. When you are next to the water, the sun may be hot, but you are not going to feel it, because the hands of God are going to cover you. You are going to stay green: you are going to stay with wisdom. Stay in the green.

precepts.why:
When you stay green, your sister stays green and your brother stays green. “She openeth her mouth with wisdom”: that is a sister who stays in the green, the little plant by the water. When she opens her mouth, she opens it with wisdom.

“And in her tongue is the law of kindness.” When a sister doesn't fulfil this verse, she wonders why her house is not blessed, why she and her husband are going through things. It is because that verse is not being fulfilled in that house. Open your mouth like a sister that has wisdom, like somebody who has some understanding.

Any time the thought comes out, Can I explain myself?, it is of the devil. If you think you are ready for that war, Satan is going to make you look stupid; it is better to just listen. When you are in the battle just trying to fight your way through, you find out afterwards, I didn't see myself doing that, because Satan is in the mix of everything. The correction that is given is good both for the one who gives it and the one who receives it. That same knife that cuts you cuts the brother who corrected you, and he says, I have to get my own thing together too. If you hadn't been corrected, he would never have thought of it. So why are you so angry when brothers or sisters check you?

You want to be like that little green tree next to the water that stays green. “If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.” What the Lord is letting us know is that this whole life is going to be hard times. You finally get a little break, you feel joy at a feast, and the next day after the feast you might get fired. It is never going to be where you have it all going on; it is always going to be trouble. So when these things happen, you don't run. You stay still and you fight.

This whole world is there to challenge us. Satan tells you that you are going to be good out there in the world, but that good is just for the moment, and then the full attack comes. Once you know where you came from, where in this world can you go to hide? You cannot challenge the world that is set up to challenge you if you can't take correction. The world challenges you while you challenge it; you challenge yourself and you make yourself great. You don't just lie down because Satan knocks you down. You wake the hell up, get up and walk.

You are going to have to go through things, and when you go through things, that is how you examine how strong your strength is. Did you stand when the correction came? Did you accept it? The whole Bible is about correction. A brother being corrected agreed to the charge, yes, and to the next charge, yes, and the next, yes, and then asked, Can I explain myself? That is stupidity, and that is how people really think, all day, every day.

The knowledge of God is very important; we don't walk away from it, we embrace it. “The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge”. That is the young men in the war room who want that water, that knowledge, that wisdom, out there reading. Yet there are brothers who have been with us for years, grown men, who never show up in the war room and have to be begged like kids. You have to seek out that wisdom. What happens to you when we're gone? While we are here, seek out the wisdom God gave us. Any time you see leadership, seek that wisdom out; don't let any man have to tell you.

Where is that knowledge going to come from? The understanding is going to come from the leadership. So how would you ignore leadership if you are seeking knowledge? We hope you are all here to seek knowledge from leadership, from the bishop to the deacons, captains and officers. One brother wanted to be in the hot seat, even wanted to be rebuked. But a brother took the 50 and then said he didn't know it was going to be that hard: he was looking for a 401k, a pension plan, a retirement plan. There is no retirement in this truth. You have to keep doing the work; we are unprofitable servants, and to whom much is given, much is required.

At the headquarters, the old Connecticut camp drove two hours to the mission, and not just on the Sabbath, but Tuesday, Wednesday and the high holy days, and never complained, even with a homeless man in the car, because that was brotherly love and because they knew what they had been in the world. They weren't looking for the retirement plan; they were looking for the work.

“But the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.” When leadership is up in here, the man that seeks knowledge goes to where the wisdom is; the fool looks for who he can talk sports and football with, or his job for the week. Some brothers think they already have it, full of wisdom and power, and don't need leadership. Then when the correction comes, they move like a woman, so much emotion.

This whole Bible is about knowledge, wisdom and understanding, and we have to seek them out. That is the water, the pure water. “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart”. Your pastors could have been the negroes in the world who just seek after covetousness, but the Lord led you to the pastors after his heart, the brothers able to help you build and help you see yourself.

“Which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.” Read it correctly: the pastors according to his heart will feed you with knowledge and understanding. So that is who you go to seek knowledge and understanding from; why keep away? Some brothers go on the quest just to have fun, not for wisdom or knowledge or understanding at all. You don't see them for days. They weren't on the quest; they were on a cruise. That is what we are seeking for, and that is what leadership is there for.

sense.text:
“Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” The Lord says, I know you; I sanctified you. This was Jeremiah's purpose in this life: God sent Jeremiah with a purpose.

Whatever weakness is in you, brother, is not a coincidence, and where you sit is not a coincidence. Always ask yourself that. You could have been in the world, maybe killed, maybe entertaining all types of foolishness. Why are you here? Is there a reason why you are here?

“Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.” Jeremiah felt he was too young and that it was not the time, like some of you think now. It is like in Haggai: is it time for you to build your own house? What about the house of the Lord? But God knows who you are. He didn't make a mistake calling you up in here, so don't doubt yourself while you're here. Maybe it's too much work. The hell with it: just do it.

“But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee”. That is a commandment: the Lord says, I send you, and you are going to do everything I tell you to do. Jeremiah didn't have a choice; it was his from birth. So it is with you and me: from birth we are ordained to do this work we are doing. Don't let Satan come and take the prize away from you. You were ordained from the beginning; you have a purpose in this life.

“And whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.” That is what we do: whatever the Lord commands us, that is what we speak. Christ is a black man. Christ is sending us to the twelve tribes of the house of Israel. Christ died only for the twelve tribes, and we don't give a damn if you don't believe that.

“Be not afraid of their faces”. Some of us are afraid of the faces, and that is why some give up. The dumbest thing ever heard is, I used to be an Israelite; you never hear anybody say, I used to be a Christian, with so much passion.

“For I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.” We have to put our trust in him. He let Jeremiah know: I know who you are; whatever you go through is of me; I will deliver you out of everything. There are going to be some sad nights, some affliction, some tribulation. Don't worry: he is all in all. So don't say, I just lost my job, I don't think I should come on the Sabbath, I'm just going through things right now. Everybody is going through things. That is why we are here among each other, to comfort one another.
“Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.” The Lord says, I am going to put my words in your mouth.

“See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms”. Jeremiah was set over the nations, a bunch of nations, his own included. Just imagine hearing the voice of the Lord say, I set you over nations, over kingdoms. The hell with that low self-esteem of yours; the Lord says shake it off.

“To root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.” The black man doesn't think he has the strength; God says you do have the strength. You have the strength to build, to build brothers and to build sisters, and you also have the strength to prophesy the destruction of these nations out here. That is what prophecy is: we have to prophesy their destruction, because this place is an evil place. But that comes with a lot of responsibility.

precepts.why:
That responsibility is a lot of work, and when you throw yourself out there, Satan is going to come, so you have to prepare for it. “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil”: that is what Satan is. Your adversary is going to constantly mess with you as soon as you pick it up and acknowledge who you are; he says, now I've got him. “As a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”.

Who do you think Satan walks up and down looking to devour? Not the brother sitting on his behind doing nothing. You're a bum; Satan isn't looking for you; he has you exactly where he found you. He is looking for the brother who puts in a lot of work. He is looking for these leaders, to devour them, and for our young men. That is why the media is full of porn: Satan is at work. If he cannot get to you, he gets to your wife, your children, your dog. The little dog gets killed; the chickens you were raising all get eaten; the goats all get killed. Satan is going to mess with the men doing the work, because he will get to anything he needs to get your attention. That is how powerful he is.

Be sober, because when you are sober you are paying attention, alert to things, and you start to see the work of Satan. Satan comes as regular things, and if you are paying attention you say, there's Satan right there; I can't do that. Brothers who travel feel him come full force; he had already attacked them at the airport. The work is not easy, but one thing we know: there is a reward for what we are doing. So we don't complain or talk about balancing our life. This is our profession; the little job you have is temporary.

sense.text:
Christ shows here how the devil works. “Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer”. Christ was talking to the apostles, and he is telling us today that these things are going to happen to us. A lot of people think their life is supposed to be easy. Peter said that if anybody stepped to Christ he would do his thing, and Christ told him to be quiet. You hear brothers tell a leader, I would die for you, and then they are nowhere to be found: the same one who moved back into the world over a little correction. How are you going to die for a leader when you punk out of correction? You are going to suffer as a leader. When that suffering comes, you stand; you don't bench.

“Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried”. The prophecy is that some of us are going to prison, for the souls of our people and the love we have for them. Are you ready to go to prison? Some can hardly iron their purple shirt. That work comes with a trying: you don't know when it will come or what affliction will come. But wherever you find yourself, know that is where the Lord put you. Teach and preach. If you find yourself somewhere you cannot teach and preach, the Lord put you there because there are things in you he wants to purify: start fasting, start praying, purify the body and purify the mind, and the Lord will take you out of that jail. Some will do ten years, some three; some brothers can't even do one day: I like teaching, but I don't want the jail time.

“And ye shall have tribulation ten days”. I like teaching, but I don't like the tribulation part. Christ said, if it were possible, remove it from me, but he had to go through it, and it is the same with us.

“Be thou faithful unto death”. In that moment there might be jail time or there might be death; whatever state you find yourself in, be faithful in it. Afflicted, tortured, one of your eyes taken out, one of your arms taken off: be faithful, brother. That is part of the walk; you have to bear the pain. And the body is not you. Your soul is you.

precepts.why:
This is how we know these things will happen to us: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” The scripture says we are going to go to jail, we are going to be afflicted, tribulation is going to hit us. So when these things happen, you remember reading it: I cannot fight it; this is of the Lord; I have to humble myself to see what he is trying to show me.

Don't go out here being a snake thinking you'll get away with it, selling your soul for nothing, for a little seventy dollars. The day you sit in the furnace of fire, all those thoughts and all that evil you did toward your brother, all that breaking bread smiling in your brother's face, all the things you did in secret against the congregation, will be there. You have your own personal demonic sin you are fighting with. Get rid of that first, before you think about lining a brother or a sister up for their failure.

You must prepare your soul for the pain that is coming; this is war. “Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” The purpose of the wicked is to overthrow our goings.

So do you think Satan is sleeping? There is a spiritual Satan and a physical Satan, and they are at work all the time, working as a team. Either he gets in your head while you sleep or he gets in your head while you are awake, and at your job Satan comes jumping in people, and you see them react some type of way.

sense.text:
This is Christ in a scene healing people, and it shows how Satan works. “And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”. The demon in him cast him into the fire to hurt him, and into the water to kill him. We do that every day. What was religion given to us for? To destroy us. The club, the partying, the religion: that is us destroying ourselves, because Satan is in us, and we think it is the way. It is not the way.

In the world, when we got our paycheck, we spent it on things we didn't need, in the club, at the barbecue, partying. That was the fire. In the black community it is guaranteed some gang sprays up the place, or there is some beef where somebody pulls a gun and sprays the whole club; or you get drunk, jump behind the wheel, have a car accident and lose your legs or your arm. That is the same demon in us that told us this was cool. Now we learn that those were demons in us that allowed us to do what we were doing.
“If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.” Everything is possible to him that believes. Your belief is your power; the word believe has power in it.

“Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.” He is saying, strengthen my belief. When you notice that you keep going through things, ask the Lord, strengthen my faith. Sometimes your faith is weak, and that is why Satan keeps attacking you. Go fast and ask the Lord why you are weak in this, and to strengthen your faith.

“Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.” He had a dumb spirit and a deaf spirit. Did we not have a dumb spirit, spending our money in the club? At the carnival on Eastern Parkway, in the mix of a bunch of no-good negroes up to no good: that is a dumb spirit, to leave your house and go with them. Then you think it was fun, and now you get stopped, or bitten by a pit bull and can hardly go to work. You bring pain on yourself. That is the dumb spirit we were dealing with in the world. A deaf spirit means you are not listening and don't see your condition.

“And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him”, and “Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.” Now the brother arose, the dumb spirit left, and he realised he had a dumb spirit operating in him that kept throwing him into the fire and into the water. Now we wake up and say, that was some dumb thing.

There are still dumb thoughts. Brothers wake up into two or three wives. Some sisters really think every one of our sisters is going to get married in this captivity, and here is how you know it is a dumb thought: the dumb spirit comes over the single sister and tells her to go into the world, get a lord, and bring him up in here. In the world you caught nothing, and now you go and get something. Some sisters come here not to do the work but just for the ride.

Remember Jeremiah: put your hope in the Lord and your trust in the Lord. Most likely a sister complaining about getting a lord is not in the right spirit: not doing the work on the body, just looking pretty and looking for a man. Know your size. Leadership has preached it: burn the fat, do something with yourself, for God's sake. Look at yourself in the mirror before blaming leadership. Some want a lord who will accept their grown kids of 22, 23 and 24 hanging inside the house.

“Why could not we cast him out?” “This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.” That demon came out like that: you have to fast and pray for the damn demon to come out of you. Go to the Lord: Lord, remove that. Fight it, and don't let that thing conquer you. Christ saying that this kind needs fasting and prayer means there are some demons higher than other demons.

When Rachel wanted a baby she came to Jacob, and Jacob said, Am I God? Go ask God for that baby. So if you want a lord, go ask God, instead of pointing your finger at leadership because a sister who came after you already has one. Check yourself: ask her how she did it, and ask what is wrong with you. God puts people in your life for a reason, and that is why he put leadership in your life: to watch over your soul. Instead of pointing a finger at leadership, fix yourself up. Maybe you need to be the woman of Proverbs 31:26 we read and fix your mouth. People think they deserve it, but you have to earn it, and when you earn it, you sacrifice: stop eating the ice cream at night, sister, brother.

precepts.why:
You don't want to be a soul without knowledge, without anything, just there dead. You want to get this water. “Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole”. This is one Christ healed, and he found him in the temple and told him, you were just made whole. “Sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.” A dumb Christian once said that when Christ cast the demons out of people, they never sinned again.

If you continue, a worse thing comes. Say you used to be a stripper: go and sin no more. Now you've been here two years and you think, I need to go back and get this money. But the world you left two years ago is not the world you are about to go into. You think nothing moved in two years; it is a different world. Every year is a different world: sin is multiplying upon this earth, and different types of demons are jumping upon people.

“The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.” Now he became a snitch: that's the guy that healed me.

“Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole.” The father in Mark had to say, strengthen my faith; this sister's faith was strong, and Christ said, your faith healed you, sister. “And the woman was made whole from that hour”, because she believed Christ was that healing.

“And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.” Nobody in Israel had been able to cast demons out of people like that. “But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.” They went with envy.

That is why other Israelites speak much evil of the work we are doing. We are out here casting out demons, and they say, they are of Satan; they are Islam, Muslims, Christians. Come with receipts before you start talking; receipts will stop you from talking nonsense. A lot of these camps are not doing anything with their life or for the nation. They are caught up in envy, hatred, malice and deceit; even when they give you a thumbs up it is just to keep it casual, and behind the door they speak much evil of IUIC. The last time we read the Bible, it said to read the scripture and convert the people. So what job are you doing out here? Where is your work? Look at the receipts of the brothers of IUIC, at the passports alone: young men already in twelve countries, and the top leadership have already filled two or three passports. Come with your receipts before you start talking.

It is the same thing as the Pharisees: no receipt, envying the man who is healing the people. There is some sickness in us that doesn't want to see anything good for us. We have problems.

“They brought unto him many that were possessed with devils”. Look at our people today: they are possessed with devils, with legions of demons. The sister who says, since I can't find a lord in here I'm going to go in the world, is still the same woman; she never changed. She would have gone to the Lord: Lord, I don't know what I'm doing, why can't I find a lord, help me find one. If you are sincere, the Lord is going to bless you. But not every woman is going to get a lord, and if you think you came here for a lord, Satan is going to remove you out of the way. Some are just plotting, talking to other sisters, and won't go through the program.

We tell you the same thing Rachel was told: go to the Lord. There must be something you haven't fulfilled yet. You are looking without when you should look within: what does the Lord want me to learn, what does he want me to change? Some think they have already changed, but look at the thoughts that pop up in your head. If nothing is wrong with you, why would those thoughts be there? That is how you know you are of Satan.

“And he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick”. That is what the word of God does here, because we are all sick. Sometimes you need direction. Stay the course; take a cold shower and you'll be good. But don't go out here and catch a disease and then blame us for the mistake.

“There met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.” Where those demons were in those men, no man could pass, because they would fight them; yet when they saw Christ, they wanted him to remove the demons. There are people who are always in a mess, where there is never peace. A man of peace lets go of anything that is going to cost him problems: a car bought at auction with the whole bottom no good, a diesel truck that never got fixed; take it, I want my peace, I don't want all that drama. God is calling us to be at peace. Don't trouble your lord; don't trouble your wife. Sometimes it is good to humble yourself, brother or sister; when you see that spirit, take a deep breath and leave it alone. When you are afflicted at home and thinking about suicide, that is not you; demonic spirits play on your emotions. Call a brother just to talk.

“So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.” Our people today look normal, as if they are not dealing with demons, until they open their mouth. Our people had a legion of demons. That is why God picked you out of the world and brought you here: to clean you up. Some of us don't think we have demons. Do a lot of fasting and a lot of prayer, and your demon is going to show itself. There is nothing strange about being able to see your own demon.

“And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.” Do you think the demons died with the swine? They are looking for people, to jump into other people's bodies and do the same thing. That is why correction is grievous to some brothers: they don't see correction as healing. And some people live their life complaining all the time with no solution: the bathroom is dirty, so why not clean it? The hallway is dirty, so pick up a broom. Those are spirits.

sense.text: This is the power of Christ. “For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.” It is the blood that makes an atonement for your soul. Man is flesh and blood, but he also has a soul within him, and the blood is for the atonement of that soul.

precepts.why:
Remember what the blood is for: the atonement for your soul. “For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son”. When we were breaking God's law, we became enemies. “Much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.” By Christ's life we are going to be saved.

“And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.” The blood of Christ is what gives us the atonement, so that we can build upon grace. The blood of Christ is more powerful than the animal sacrifice.

The blood of Christ is the most powerful thing in this universe, because of where we were: “Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world”. In time past we walked according to what everybody in this world was doing, “according to the prince of the power of the air”: we were dealing with Satan.

“The spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience.” These are the children disobeying God's commandments. They are in the churches, in the mass, in Islam, in everything, thinking that is the way. That is not the way. The way is through God's law, statutes and commandments, to his Son Jesus the Christ; that is how they will get out of there.

Satan is working with our people in the world, because they keep no commandment, so Satan is in them. So don't listen to your parents talking about how holy they are: Satan is in them, because they are the children who disobey God's commandments. How the hell do you disobey God's commandments and call yourself holy?

“And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.” Christ gave himself as a sacrifice for us, and likewise we are going to have to do the same for our brothers and sisters: we have to become their sacrifice. When they put you to death, the Lord looks at it as a sacrifice. That is why they say that in Babylon they see your altar. What does the altar represent? They are going to put us to death out here. What did they do on the altar? Offer blood sacrifice.

The children of disobedience are the rebellious children: “Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”. If you are not covered with God's spirit, whose spirit are you covered by? The rebellious children are covered with Satan.

“For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one”: by one man's offence death went into the earth because of sin. Look at our condition. From Abraham to Moses, until today, death reigned. “Much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.” So what is the foundation we are going to run by? Jesus Christ. Because he did it, we build upon righteousness on him.

That is why it is through mercy that you make it to the doors, for as Isaiah says, our righteousness is as filthy rags. So don't be here boasting about how perfect you are. Christ said he did not come for the righteous; he came for those that were sick, so that he could heal them. When you see brothers and sisters start talking negative of leadership, they are healed already; they're good. Leave them alone. People like that you don't entertain, because you can see Satan right there.

“Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.” By the offence of one, condemnation came on all people: death came for every creature, though a few, like Elijah, Ezra and Enoch, were taken up by the chariot.

“For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.” By Christ's obedience we can build upon righteousness. By one man's sin the platform we had got messed up, but Christ did it right this time, so we can build upon him and do it right because he did it right. This is the platform we have now.

“For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory”. Christ's death is going to bring many sons into glory. That glory is a new body and a new mindset. So while you are here in this earth, keep on trying, keep on working; don't give up, don't give in, no matter what; keep on fighting. The little things you are going through, you are going to be all right.

A lot of our problems come from not letting God lead us to the way. The leaders are there to watch over your soul. People think we are here to match people up; that is not what we are here for. We are here to teach the Bible, the laws and the commandments. If you are looking for a wife or a husband, go to the Lord and ask for that. If you look deep enough at leadership, you are going to find something; so what? We are not above the law; we keep it moving. But what are you going to do about the hatred and the bitterness in your heart? How are you going to make it to the kingdom with a mindset that looks for evil?

You trust the bus even when you don't know the driver, the plane without knowing the pilot, the boat without ever meeting the captain. But when God sets leaders over you, you say, I don't trust my leadership. People are so desperate they prefer a backdoor marriage, which is hell on earth, to waiting for the Lord to bless them with a king. Marriage is a patient place; you cannot force anybody to marry you or to love you. A brother who would not wait married a sister leadership said was not ready, a sister with a legion of powerful demons, and she accused him of molesting her daughter. Another brother three months married was already beating his wife. Some of you will never be hooked up, because your spirit isn't right.

Fix yourself, and the Lord is going to bless you. When leadership tells you to burn that fat, get better health, change your diet, pick an office, do something, and you do nothing but sit there looking pretty, then when a brother asks, we are going to be straightforward. We don't walk by beauty here.

sense.text:
“Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.” Sister, if you have the thought to go out for a man in the world, you are leaning to your own understanding; brother, the same. Lean to the scriptures. Apply the scripture to your life and change with the scriptures, and then it is easy for the Lord to bless you with a king or a wife.

The hand of the Lord is not too short to do it. Whether you have two or three kids, ten kids, twelve kids, God will prove his power by doing it, and there are good brothers out here who will take you with your kids and see your need. We are still family. Be very mindful, and stay in the spirit, Israel.
